subject: SPEC: error state matrix -- 7 states, 3 unhandled (empty exam, silent localStorage, MCM voice copy)
body:
SPEC: Error State Matrix for exam.html
Map of every failure mode and what Kai sees for each

Filed by: GD spec (error-state-matrix)
For GA implementation review / validation

STATE MATRIX:

STATE 1: No ?file= param (picker mode)
Trigger: exam.html loaded with no query string
What Kai sees: the exam picker grid ('Pick Your Challenge')
Status: implemented (GA commit 6b81a49). No error state -- correct behavior.

STATE 2: File param but file not found (HTTP 404)
Trigger: exam.html?file=retake-practice-99 (file doesn't exist)
Current copy: 'Could not load retake-practice-99 (status 404).'
MCM voice copy (from error-copy-fix spec 20260222-1645): 'Test not found. Pick a different one.'
CTAs: 'Pick a different test' (back to picker) + 'Try again' (reload)
Status: copy needs update (spec filed 20260222-1645)

STATE 3: File found but JSON parse fails (corrupted/malformed file)
Trigger: data/retake-practice-1.json has invalid JSON
Current copy: 'Error reading exam data. The file may be corrupted.'
MCM voice copy: 'Can't open this test. Try a different one.'
CTAs: 'Pick a different test' only (retry is pointless, same corrupted file)
Status: copy needs update + CTA logic (hide retry button for parse failures)

STATE 4: Network error (fetch fails, file:// XHR error)
Trigger: offline, or file:// XHR onerror
Current copy: 'Network error loading {file}. Try reloading.'
MCM voice copy: "Can't connect right now. Refresh and try again."
CTAs: 'Try again' (reload) + 'Pick a different test' (in case file is the problem)
Status: copy needs update

STATE 5: Exam loaded but empty questions array
Trigger: exam JSON is valid but has { questions: [] }
Current behavior: renderQuestions() produces an empty container. Kai sees a blank exam. No error.
MCM voice copy: 'This test has no questions yet. Pick a different one.'
Status: NOT HANDLED. GA should add guard in loadExam(): if (!examData.questions || examData.questions.length === 0) { showLoadError('This test has no questions yet. Pick a different one.'); }

STATE 6: Exam loads but saveResults fails (localStorage full/unavailable)
Trigger: after grading, localStorage throws
Current behavior: try/catch silences it. Kai's score is not saved. No notification.
MCM voice copy: small inline note below scorecard: 'Score not saved (storage full). Screenshot this page.'
Status: NOT HANDLED. Silent failure is worse than a small warning.

STATE 7: MathJax fails to load (no CDN access on offline file://)
Trigger: file:// mode, CDN unavailable
Current behavior: raw LaTeX syntax shows (\frac{1}{x} instead of rendered fraction)
Status: known limitation. No fix needed -- MathJax loads correctly in Chrome from file://. Document in .agent-status.md.

ACCEPT CRITERIA FOR GA:
- State 5: add empty-questions guard in loadExam()
- State 6: add small inline note below scorecard if localStorage save throws
- States 2/3/4: update showLoadError call sites per 20260222-1645 spec (copy fix)
- State 3: hide Retry button when error is a parse failure (not a network/HTTP error)
